Lead source: organic product signup from docs-search quickstart. Team: CTO Eduardo Navarro (decision), Lead Engineer Maya Liu (integration), 1 backend, 2 frontend. Primary ask: replace brittle keyword search with vector-based doc search + reranking.
- POC scope: 10k documents, ingestion pipeline (S3 -> chunk -> embed -> upsert), evaluation on ~200 query set.
- Requirements: prefer hosted API for speed to market, public cloud only. No on-prem right now.
- Performance targets: median latency <150ms, 95th <400ms under steady 200 qps; burst handling to 500 qps with graceful degradation.
- Quality targets: top-3 precision >0.8 for FAQ-style queries; reranker to rescore top-50 dense results. Interested in Redwood suggestions for embedding dimension (512 vs 1024) and whether to use hybrid sparse/dense.

- Security: SSO/SAML is must for admin UI; need audit log examples and minimal retention policy for embeddings (30-90 days?). Also asked about KMS integration for keying secrets.
- Quote from CTO: "We need a hosted path first; if performance/cost tradeoffs good, we'll consider Dedicated next quarter."
- Sales notes: good trial engagement; cost-sensitive but willing to pay for SLA if solves latency. Next: deliver sample API calls (embed + search + rerank) using their sample dataset, include cost estimate for 10k docs + 100k queries/month.
